outgoing.name: Gender
outgoing.excerpt: Mandan has different grammatical forms that depend on gender of the addressee.

outgoing.name: Horse
outgoing.excerpt: Horses were acquired by the Mandan in the mid-18th century and were used for transportation and hunting.

outgoing.name: Maize
outgoing.excerpt: The gardens were owned and tended by the women, and they would plant corn, beans and squash, usually enough to last a single year.
